name: @role-orchestrator/remote-worker
description: M7-03 optional container/Remote Worker validation (DESIGN/SIMULATION ONLY - no real container runtime, no real network, no real TLS has ever been exercised by this package). Protocol-level simulation of an orchestrator-controlled remote execution worker over an in-memory fake transport with an injected-fault matrix: transport interruption with a surviving zombie worker (write-back refused by fencing after lease expiry), lease + fencing-token semantics REUSED from @role-orchestrator/store (monotonic per-resource fencing tokens, expired leases refuse writes, an expired slot stays blocked until the explicit reconcile step - never auto-stolen), cancellation propagation with the A26 remote analog of tree-kill (unterminable processes are honestly reported as cancel-unconfirmed, never claimed terminated), event duplicate delivery deduplicated by idempotency key (eventId), the A22 unknown-outcome path landing on RECOVERY_REQUIRED with NO auto re-run API, per-target A31 Hardened-posture refusal while no real container filesystem/network boundary evidence exists, and secret-minimal-exposure message schemas (references only, secret-shaped material rejected, closed event payloads). The package states in data and prose that a remote worker is NOT multi-tenant security.
